Q5723.reason: Drain volume and character are checked as part of every post-operative observation round, which is more accurate than a fixed daily or hourly schedule or waiting for a dressing change.

Q5725.reason: A valid treaty is supreme law under the Supremacy Clause, and a proclamation it authorizes may nullify conflicting state law when no constitutional provision forbids it.

Q5727.reason: Palmitate is a C16 acid, so β-oxidation produces 8 acetyl-CoA plus reduced cofactors that yield ATP, along with metabolic water.
